name: presto
description: Three design skills (impeccable + design-taste-frontend + emil-design-eng) stacked into one workflow. Run /magic for the full linear flow or break out into individual phases.

commands.name: magic
commands.description: Full 7-phase design flow end-to-end. On cold-start, confirms whether to run /houdini first. Pass --surprise to bypass all prompts: autonomously runs houdini in wildcard mode, then proceeds through every phase with zero questions.

commands.name: houdini
commands.description: Creative partner for the blank page. Three modes: guided (default), --auto (zero-question solo run), or comma-separated keywords as a Design Read seed.
